_review_required: PROPOSAL ONLY. Recording without operator review would be the instrument scoring itself. Correct scores, replace SPECULATIVE grades where you bring external sources, then: python dialektik.py score --dyad <this file>
stated_posture: Cross-side circulating claims in the pull window between AXIS and WEST: strait of hormuz (AXIS/WEST); tanker (AXIS/WEST); tanker (AXIS/WEST); sanctions (AXIS/WEST); closure (AXIS/WEST); mobilization (AXIS/WEST). Statement cross-bias confirms an utterance exists, not that it is true — the desk grades circulation, the analyst judges content. FILL: the parties' official stated posture from primary statements before scoring.

sources: UN Comtrade; national customs releases; sanctioned-trade tracking
trade.rationale: A watched-channel pull cannot observe trade flows. Unscorable from this corpus; score only from external trade data.

sources: Lloyd's List; war-risk premia; AIS transit data (verify externally)
transit.rationale: Proposed 2 — interrupted episodically, restored quickly. Derived from corpus signals only.
transit.rule: RULE: graded kinetic strike on a transit-bearing anchor (bandar abbas) with no graded closure event in the window -> propose 2. Corpus absence of a closure event is NOT world absence; verify against Lloyd's List / AIS traffic before recording.

sources: Official notification records; third-party mediation reporting
deconfliction.rationale: Hotlines, notification channels and advance warning are invisible to this corpus. Unscorable from the pull.

target_selection.rationale: The corpus supplies the STRUCK set only: bandar abbas, bushehr, tehran. Scoring requires the decisive-target reference list — what was available and NOT struck — which is a judgment against external knowledge, not a corpus fact. Evidence attached; score is yours.

sources: OFAC/EU/UN designations, licences and carve-out texts
sanctions.rationale: Sanctions claims circulate cross-side in this pull. Carve-out and enforcement structure is only scorable from the regime documents themselves.

sources: Lloyd's war-risk premia; IATA/NOTAM records; correspondent-banking reporting
civil_continuity.rationale: Insurance premia, aviation and banking continuity are invisible to this corpus. Tanker-related circulation attached as context only.

sources: Pre-registered KKR projection; options/futures data for the declared instrument
market_prepositioning.rationale: Pre-registration status: none supplied. Excluded by rule until a KKR projection declares instrument, window and threshold BEFORE the events. Pass --prereg-id to attach one.
